target_customer: Consumers buying beauty products through live streams, and beauty sellers
problem: Live stream shopping for beauty products was popular in Asia but not yet established in the US; Lalabox offered a mobile app for live shopping deals.
business_model: Live commerce marketplace with take on sales (not stated in sources)

founders.name: Kirill Avery
previous_startups: Built an HQ Trivia style app for Europe reaching 15M downloads (per YC page)

founders.name: Yurii Kyparus (Yatsenko)
previous_startups: oznaka.ai (influencer finding tool, per YC page)

competitors.name: Whatnot
competitors.what: US livestream shopping marketplace for collectibles

competitors.name: NTWRK
competitors.what: Mobile livestream shopping app built around limited-edition drops

technical_complexity.rationale: Low-latency live video, in-stream checkout and a mobile app are standard but non-trivial; a team of four with Facebook and Google engineering experience could build it.

defensibility.rationale: No exclusive supply or network effect was shown, and larger platforms and white-label vendors offered the same feature.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TikTok live shopping grew for beauty brands (Glossy), and funded rivals raised large rounds in 2021.

market_need_then: In 2021 US livestream shopping platforms raised large rounds (Whatnot $50M in May 2021, Popshop Live $20M, Supergreat $10M for beauty per a search summary), signalling investor interest; no independent consumer demand data for Lalabox found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Playful 'unique deals' framing on the site

branding.community_and_virality: TikTok and Instagram accounts exist at @lalaboxio; no evidence of traction.

brand_strength.rationale: Brand searches found no press or community about Lalabox; a review site noted not enough public signal.

outcome_analysis: Lalabox was a four person Winter 2021 team building a beauty live shopping app, with a reported seed of about $130K, while better funded Whatnot, NTWRK and Popshop Live raised tens of millions that year. The YC page lists the founders as former founders and Kirill Avery moved to alien.org, but no shutdown post or stated cause was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factor is assigned.
notes: The $130K seed rests on a single database (CB Insights), whose date of January 1, 2021 may be a placeholder; recorded as 2021. Crunchbase and CB Insights say founded 2020 and Los Angeles, YC says 2021 and San Francisco. A founder essay mentions $500K personal fundraising in 2022, which is not a Lalabox round. lalabox.io shows an app page whose seller email uses the domain matt.fun, suggesting a link to another app called Matt; unconfirmed. Competitor sources are search summaries dated June and July 2021, a few months after the W21 batch. A first outcome search returned only an unrelated Indonesian Lolabox. Downgraded to depth 1: the researcher reported a required competitor search or funding cross-check was not run separately, so the record is redone.
